lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's one over twenty-seven? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 1/27? Nope!

lines.text: An ant walks along a cube's edges. Each minute, it picks one of three edges at random.
lines.caption: An ant walks along a cube's edges. Each minute, it picks one of 3 edges at random.

lines.text: What's the chance it's at the farthest corner after three minutes?
lines.caption: What's the chance it's at the farthest corner after 3 minutes?

lines.text: G is three edges away. So every step must go farther!
lines.caption: G is 3 edges away. So every step must go farther!

lines.text: Step one: all three edges go farther. Three over three.
lines.caption: Step 1: all 3 edges go farther. 3/3.

lines.text: Step two: one edge goes back. Two over three.
lines.caption: Step 2: 1 edge goes back. 2/3.

lines.text: Step three: only one edge reaches G. One over three.
lines.caption: Step 3: only 1 edge reaches G. 1/3.

lines.text: Multiply them all. That's two over nine!
lines.caption: Multiply them all. That's 2/9!

lines.text: One over twenty-seven was the trap.
lines.caption: 1/27 was the trap.

lines.text: Did you get two over nine? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 2/9? Tell me below!
